tabs.label: Die Speisekarte
tabs.instructions: A menu is usually divided into the same parts. Look for these headings.
text:
• Vorspeisen – starters
  • Hauptgerichte – main courses
  • Beilagen – side dishes
  • Nachtisch / Dessert – dessert
  • Getränke – drinks
  • Tagesgericht – dish of the day

tabs.label: Wichtige Wörter
tabs.instructions: These words matter when you cannot eat something.
text:
• vegetarisch – without meat or fish
  • vegan – without any animal products
  • glutenfrei – gluten-free
  • Ich bin allergisch gegen … – I am allergic to …
  • mit / ohne … – with / without …
